clips.title: The story
paras: Ban'ethil Barrow Den is a sacred subterranean sanctuary hollowed out within the roots of Teldrassil. Originally created as a resting place for the sleeping Druids of the Talon, the cavern complex has recently fallen into chaos. The corrupted furbolgs of the Gnarlpine tribe have overrun its chambers, turning a place of peaceful slumber into a perilous den of madness.

Barrow dens serve as sacred resting chambers where night elf druids slumber while projecting their spirits into the Emerald Dream. Ban'ethil Barrow Den was dedicated specifically to sheltering the Druids of the Talon as they communed with nature. Divided into upper and lower subterranean chambers, the den once resonated with tranquil reverie and deep meditative magic. However, the affliction sweeping Teldrassil's wildlife did not spare the Gnarlpine furbolgs, who invaded the complex, turning its hollowed halls into a fortified warren.
